page.title: Contact our team
page.description: Questions about your account, billing, or how to get the most out of Nexora? Reach out — a real person on our team will get back to you.

email.title: Email
email.description: Best for account, billing, or detailed questions.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Best for quick questions and fast replies.

expectations.title: What to expect
expectations.description: We're a small team, so replies come from a real person, not a ticket queue. Email is typically answered within 1 business day; Telegram messages are often answered within a few hours during the day (Mon–Fri).

responseTime.question: How quickly will I get a response?
responseTime.answer: Most emails are answered within 1 business day. Telegram is usually faster, often within a few hours during business hours (Monday–Friday). Messages sent over the weekend are answered the next business day.

whatToInclude.question: What should I include when I reach out?
whatToInclude.answer: Let us know the email address on your account, what you were trying to do, and any error message you saw. A screenshot helps a lot if you're reporting something visual or unexpected.

billingQuestions.question: Can support help with billing and subscription questions?
billingQuestions.answer: Yes. We can help with plan changes, invoices, and cancellations. For self-service, Settings → Subscription and Billing let you manage most of this yourself at any time.

phoneSupport.question: Is phone support available?
phoneSupport.answer: Not currently — as a small team, email and Telegram let us give every message proper attention and keep responses fast and personal.

languages.question: What languages can I contact support in?
languages.answer: Feel free to write in Russian, English, or Ukrainian — our team is comfortable replying in all three.
